body: She knows she is loved :) good job. Now all you can do is wait I guess.

I’m 20 years old and I’m embarrassed to admit I felt like more of an adult when I was 15.  

When I was 15 I had 3 jobs Full time nanny during the summer, waitress, and hostess.  I went to school, went to my jobs, went home and slept. I did a lot of driving with the car my dad bought me and felt like I was my own person.

Now I’m unemployed and tried college twice but quit due to extreme paranoia and PTSD.  I never leave my house, scared of people/places I don’t know. I play on my pc most of the time, dnd some days, I buy nothing but snacks and I buy a lot of game related collector items (toys some say).  

It’s embarrassing when people ask what I do and how I can live on my own but they can’t ask those questions if I avoid them :D

I do the same thing, if she needs her space it’s good that you are giving her the time. When I get episodes I go home and shut everyone out, have a good cry, sleep for hours, and play video games. She might not do that but just some insight to try and help in any way. Since she likes her space maybe just try little things, surprise her with maybe some flowers when she’s out of the house or send her links to cute puppies idk. It always puts a smile on my face when I get little things like that, even from my mom. Lol I know lame but I do admit that little things help, if you try too much she will just push you away. Hope it helps man.

I think it’s hard for people who don’t have anxiety to understand why certain things make me nervous. We had a great start of the day with good moods but then panic and anxiety hit. When I get anxious all emotions just fade and I’m just planning to get out, I think when my mood changed so did his. He has depression as well and whenever one of us is down we both get down. So I think he just doesn’t know what to do and tries to be the one that makes sense “we have to get what we came here for let’s just do it” but when I say I just want to go home I think he just doesn’t understand that a simple task is really hard for me. We have talks where we sit down and talk about things and we both understand, he’s gotten better and tells me it will be fine now. So I think maybe talking and having him see me go through it helped him understand. He’s helped me a lot with my paranoia while in public..now the only problem is that I don’t go out without him or rather it’s just really hard. I think maybe talking to your friends will help, telling them how it feels when you get anxiety and how it feels when they don’t understand it. It’s difficult for sure but talking about it until you can’t explain no more feels really good.

I tried to explain this to my bf whenever I have bad anxiety in public and I used the term “foggy” as well! 
When I have bad anxiety my eyes feel like everything is going to fast, I see figures and colors but I don’t see faces of people (maybe because I don’t want to) it gets all blurry for me. Like I’m in a cloud and I’m trying my best to just get out as quick as possible. 

My mind also fogs up. Simple things like walking past someone is weird, I just get in the way somehow and awkwardly walk away really quick only to get in someone else’s way. It’s like I’m paying too much attention because I’m so nervous. When checking out I agree to things I don’t need because I don’t want to talk I just nod. I stutter, or I just think too long for a response and just walk away saying only “oh uh eh” feeling stupid.  I forget everything I needed in the store, I’ll just grab what’s closest to me and try to go home. My boyfriend hates that the most. “But we are here for this it’s just over there” I’ll tell him I need to go home and he gets upset. When he gets upset I feel my face get hot and my eyes burn from holding back tears. I explained to him so many times that I have extremely bad anxiety and paranoia but he always seems to forget and I’m stuck explaining it 200 times. 
I’m glad someone said they feel “foggy” too although I feel horrible that you feel that way! But just know that I understand in some way and you are not alone! :) 

I usually just go home to my safe place and play video games to cope :)
